name: Tableau
shortInfo: Tableau is an analytics solution that allows users to connect, analyze, and share their data.
brief: Tableau is a powerful data visualization tool that helps businesses derive valuable insights from their data
about:
The Tableau Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Tableau platform in an automated manner.

Check more about api documentation [here](https://help.tableau.com/current/api/rest_api/en-us/REST/rest_api_ref_data_sources.htm#publish_data_source).
availableSync:
[Publish New Datasource](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/tableau/syncs/publish-new-datasource.html)

This sync can be used to publish a new data source from your data warehouse to the Tableau platform.

[Update Data in Hyper Connection](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/tableau/syncs/update-data-in-hyper-connection.html)

This sync can be used to modify data in a published data source that has a live-to-Hyper connection from your data warehouse to the Tableau platform.
